name: DroidFinestra (x64)
author: hamed7ir
description: DroidFinestra is a Windows GUI for scrcpy that mirrors and controls an Android phone over USB or Wi-Fi. It keeps per-device profiles, builds the scrcpy command line from the chosen profile, pairs phones over Wi-Fi and shows scrcpy's live output. This package carries the official scrcpy release with Google's adb and runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11; it needs the .NET Framework 4.0 and, for its adb, the Universal C Runtime, which both include. DroidFinestra launches scrcpy without modifying it; scrcpy is by Genymobile.
dependencies: .NET Framework 4.0 or later — built into Windows 10 and 11
Universal C Runtime — built into Windows 10 and 11; needed by the bundled adb
USB debugging enabled on the Android phone
instructionSteps: Run the installer. It installs per user into %LocalAppData%\Programs\DroidFinestra and needs no administrator rights; it checks the requirements first and reports anything missing.
At the SmartScreen warning choose More info, then Run anyway — the files are not signed.
On the phone, enable USB debugging (Developer options), then connect it by USB and accept the USB-debugging prompt on the phone.
In DroidFinestra choose New profile, start from a preset, and press Launch. DroidFinestra shows the scrcpy command line, then scrcpy's live output.

For Wi-Fi: on the phone open Wireless debugging and choose Pair device with pairing code; in DroidFinestra open the menu, choose Pair a phone over Wi-Fi, and enter the pairing address and code, then the connect address. Addresses are typed, not discovered.
